# TargetedQuarantine

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network-level intervention strategy that selectively removes or isolates high-risk nodes (e.g., high-degree or high-centrality) to contain SIS-model cyber epidemics. Provides a topology-aware mitigation framework directly applicable to securing interconnect fabrics and network-on-chip architectures against cascading failures.
